Andrew, your DC04 on Shop···· is paid but still hasn't shipped, and I'm sorry, that's far longer than it should be. We wrote to you on September 4 about the delay and I don't have a confirmed new ship date from the manufacturer yet, so I'm not going to guess one.

The options from that email still stand: swap to 3x Hammer DC02 at no extra cost, a full refund, or keep waiting.

I've pinged the team for the current date. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in. Which would you like?
Could you switch me to a DC06? It is on sale right now for nearly the same price and appears to be in stock.

Yes, the DC06 is genuinely on the shelf, 57 units, and it ships within 2 business days.

Price-wise it's not quite even: your DC04 line is $299 and the DC06 is $379.99 on the sale price, so the difference is $80.99. That gets emailed to you as an invoice and the unit ships once it's paid. Same order number.

You also still hold the $50 code HD-•••••• from our September 4 email.

Want me to make the swap?
If I can use the $50 code and the difference is $30.99 That would be fair, its been such a long delay and inconvenience would you be able to make that work for me?

That's a fair ask, and I want to get it done for you.

Here's the honest bit: that code applies at checkout, and a swap difference goes out as an invoice, so I can't drop it onto the $80.99 myself. Applying your $50 against the swap is the team's call, so I've put it to them now with exactly what you asked for.

Stay in the chat, Andrew, one of them will jump in, and you get it in your email either way. The D.06 stock is there, so nothing is lost by waiting a few minutes.
Handed to the team · Code can't be applied to a swap invoice from my side; needs approval on the $50.
The team has it with your exact numbers, $30.99 to you after the $50 code. I'll commit the swap here the moment they give the go-ahead.
Okay that sounds fair to me, thank you.

Thanks for being patient with this one, Andrew. Nothing more needed from you right now, the swap is teed up and I'll run it as soon as the $50 is signed off. You'll see the updated order email when it goes through, and the DC06 ships within 2 business days after that.
Great, then I would just follow the link and pay the $30.99 and once that is done it will ship?

That's it, yes. Once the $50 is approved and I run the swap, the invoice email comes with a payment link. You pay it, the hold comes off, and the DC06 goes out within 2 business days from there, tracking to this same email.

One thing I won't promise yet is the exact invoice amount, since the $50 still needs the team's sign-off. If they approve it, the link reads $30.99.
Sounds good!

Before you go, one thing: back in September we offered you three DC02s at no extra cost, and you stayed with the DC04. What made you pass on that one?
Purely the space available in my office.
Makes sense, three boxes take three times the room. Is it the desk space, or more about the noise and heat in a room you work in?
The desk space, and having to keep an eye on 3 miners instead of 1.

Understood, one unit to watch beats three. That's useful, thank you for telling me.

I'll come back here as soon as the $50 is cleared and run the swap, and the invoice email follows straight after.
Thank you

You're welcome, Andrew. Sorry again for how long the DC04 dragged on, and thanks for sticking with us.

A copy of this whole conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have the numbers in writing, and you can reply to it to reach us again.
Sounds good, just let me know when your side is complete.
Will do. The moment the $50 is signed off I'll run the swap here and tell you, and the invoice with the payment link follows right away. Nothing else needed from you in the meantime.
Any update, its been quite a while.

Sorry, Andrew, no answer back yet. The team went offline for the day and picks this up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the decision comes to your email, so you don't need to sit here.

Nothing has been lost: the DC06 is still on the shelf and your order is unchanged.

If you'd rather not wait, I can run the swap right now at the full $80.99 difference and let the $50 be settled after. Your call.
